steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and review the required project management education hours. The CAPM requires no prior work experience—making it accessible to professionals new to the field who want to formalize their PM knowledge.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required curriculum into an efficient schedule, allowing Midland professionals to earn their education hours without extended classroom commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Complete your PMI application with documentation of your secondary degree and completed education hours. Pay the PMI exam fee to officially register for the CAPM examination and secure your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and instructor guidance to build confidence. On exam day, demonstrate your mastery of project management fundamentals and earn your CAPM credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units across the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Granite PM Academy supports your ongoing professional growth with continuing education and renewal guidance.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth pursuing for Midland oil and gas project managers?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Midland's energy sector—anchored by major operators like Chevron, Occidental Petroleum, ConocoPhillips, and Diamondback Energy, plus service giants like Halliburton and Schlumberger—increasingly values PMP and CAPM credentials to standardize project delivery on large capital initiatives. While not universally mandated, certified candidates typically enjoy a competitive edge in hiring and advancement, especially as companies scale operations across the Permian Basin.

fq_items.question: Which Midland employers actively hire CAPM-certified project managers?
fq_items.answer: Energy operators, oilfield services firms, and support industries across Midland actively recruit certified project managers. Beyond oil and gas, Midland Memorial Hospital, Midland Independent School District, the City of Midland, and regional construction and logistics firms also value the CAPM credential to strengthen project governance. The certification signals competence to employers managing complex, budget-sensitive work across multiple sectors.
